experiments.interpretation: Ceiling arm UNDERPERFORMS the full baseline pipeline at pose25 despite privileged GT pose -- not the expected result. Most likely cause: the ceiling test still uses the same area-weighted chamfer, so log_beta_scales for distal joints is starved the same way the full pipeline is (H3), and there is no deform_verts budget to absorb genuine shape deviation. Conflates H3 and H6 rather than isolating capacity.
experiments.prediction_supported: NOT AS EXPECTED -- does not establish a clean capacity floor
experiments.next: a follow-up combining this ceiling design with Rank 5's leg-protected sampler would be needed to isolate pure capacity from the sampling confound; not run this cycle

experiments.interpretation: H4 (pose-dependent cross-leg confusion) strongly supported. H2 (pose-independent within-leg mismatch) NOT cleanly supported -- within-leg mismatch stays high (0.68-0.84 on pretarsus) throughout the sweep but is not flat/noise-only either (rho=-0.57, p=0.18, underpowered at n=7). The Section 6/10 H2-vs-H4 mechanism separation is directionally consistent but not decisively confirmed by this sweep alone.
experiments.prediction_supported: PARTIALLY -- H4 supported, H2 inconclusive (not falsified, not confirmed)
experiments.next: treat within-leg mismatch as consistently severe (not pose-driven) rather than flat; do not claim clean H2/H4 separation without more conditions or a within-specimen paired design
